chapter: Southern Illinois roadhouse and St. Louis
title: Recording four tunes for Okeh with Creath
summary: Joe made four sides with Creath for Okeh but never heard them and would love a set.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: You recorded with Charlie Creath, didn't you?
Yes, I made four tunes. But I never heard them.
You don't remember who they were for or anything? What company?
They were for Okeh Records. I remember that. Whether they ever came out good or...

No. And I haven't... I've met one who said that he heard them, and I said, 'Man, I'd give a million dollars for a set of them.' I can't think who it was. And he said... Maybe it was Zutty. He said, 'Maybe I'll try to get them. Maybe Marge can get them for you or something.' And that's the last I heard of them.
